text:
Maya: Quick notes from AtlasGrid onboarding — two asks tied to renewal (~4w): 1) a single "ledger" CSV that maps feature -> route -> tokens -> USD (FP&A needs to allocate spend to feature owners), 2) a configurable alert digest (daily summary + ability to mute noisy routes during business hours).
Leo: Can you grab their exact CSV column order from the recording? Need to drop into productboard.
Maya: Quote from their finance lead: 'We need a one-row-per-feature export we can drop into our cost allocation flow. Screenshots = no-go.' Also: 'Product teams ignore 50+ pings/day; a digest would be perfect.'
Ravi: Dev quick take: if route aggregations exist, CSV export + download UI ~8-10 dev days. Adding accurate USD requires pricing join and org discounts lookup: +2-3w for QA. Digest + per-route mute windows behind FF ~1w. If they need per-feature attribution automated, add tagging surface ~1-2w.
Priya: Renewal risk flagged. AtlasGrid said they'd accept an interim CSV with feature column blank if we commit to shipping automated feature attribution within 3 weeks and they can beta. They offered to validate outputs.
AM-Kate: Please treat as high-touch. I'll surface this in renewal prep. If CS can provide a stopgap (weekly manual export) until product ships, that should buy breathing room.
Maya: They uploaded a sample CSV layout and a spreadsheet mapping some route ids -> feature names to the shared drive (link).
Leo: Proposal: ship interim CSV (route, tokens, USD if possible) + offer CS-run weekly export until full mapping exists. Then follow with UI to manage route->feature tags and automated USD mapping.
Ravi: I'll spike the pricing join tomorrow and confirm whether discounts are a blocker. If join exists, interim with USD could be 10 business days; if not, interim w/o USD in 5 days, full in ~4 weeks.
Priya: Action items: 1) Ravi confirm pricing join + ETA in 48h; 2) Maya confirm AtlasGrid beta and upload final sample columns; 3) AM-Kate note renewal impact in CRM and mark PB ticket. Check-in 72h.
product-bot: Created PB-10021 "AtlasGrid: ledger export + alert-digest" tags=[cs, renewal-risk, telemetry].
AM-Kate: I'll add a renewal note and ask AE to mention the interim support option on the renewal call.
Maya: AtlasGrid also requested the digest include a short 'why this alert fired' line so PMs can triage quickly.
Ravi: Noted — that'll change digest formatting but low lift. I'll post blockers or confirm estimates in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
Priya: Adding this to weekly renewal sweep. Keeping it hot. :fire:
